title.zh: 部门工资前三高的所有员工

desc.zh: 并列不占新名次：按部门保留前三个不同工资层级的所有员工。
desc.en: Keep every employee on the top three distinct salary levels in each department.

complexity: O(n log n + d) expected time; O(n + d) auxiliary space, plus O(k) output

concepts.name: Dense rank
concepts.description: One plus the number of larger distinct salaries in the same department.

concepts.name: Group boundaries
concepts.description: Restart ranking for each department ID.
